chapters.title: 01 · The trillion-dollar workforce problem
chapters.text:
American businesses face a two-trillion-dollar productivity problem: Gallup’s estimate of the annual U.S. cost of employee disengagement. Its 2019 estimate put voluntary turnover at another trillion dollars a year.

Inside a company, those burdens become concrete. A bad hire consumes recruiting, onboarding, and management time. An unfilled role delays work. When a valuable person leaves, experience and relationships leave too. Gallup estimates replacing a leader or manager costs around twice their salary.

Companies invest in people and strategy. The opportunity is to turn that investment into stronger execution, higher productivity, and talent that stays. That is where XQ Workforce AI comes in.

chapters.title: 02 · Great strategy needs great execution
chapters.text:
The strategy-execution gap is expensive. In 2008, John Kotter reported that seventy percent of needed changes failed, stalled, or disappointed; only ten percent of his cases delivered results far beyond expectations.

PMI’s 2025 research, covering more than fifty-eight hundred professionals, found that only half of projects fully succeed. McKinsey reports that fewer than one in three transformations both improve performance and sustain the gains.

Behind the numbers are everyday execution barriers: unclear priorities, weak alignment, inconsistent accountability, and managers struggling to turn a plan into action. Human capital sits at the center of strategic success. Strengthen the people side, and you strengthen execution.

chapters.title: 03 · Make alignment pay
chapters.text:
Poor implementation consumes real money. PMI reported in 2014 that organizations lost one hundred nine million dollars for every billion invested in projects and programs. Its 2021 research put wasted investment at nine point four percent. Applied to a ten-million-dollar initiative, that rate represents nine hundred forty thousand dollars.

Alignment offers a powerful lever. PMI’s 2014 findings showed strategic initiatives meeting their goals sixty-five percent of the time with high alignment, compared with thirty-five percent with low alignment.

XQ connects strategic priorities with leadership, manager capability, and employee behavior. The investment case starts with helping organizations capture more value from the plans they already fund.

chapters.title: 04 · The solution: XQ Workforce AI
chapters.text:
XQ Workforce AI brings personalized employee guidance, manager coaching, and workforce insight into one connected experience.

An employee prepares for a difficult conversation. A manager connects a development goal to what motivates that person. A leader sees whether team actions support the business priority.

This is the workforce experience we are building. DISC, Driving Forces, emotional intelligence, Acumen, and competencies give coaching a deeper starting point. Role expectations and performance evidence connect that insight to the work.

Employees gain a guide. Managers gain a coaching partner. Leaders gain a clearer view of execution. Better understanding becomes practical action throughout the working day.

chapters.title: 05 · Find the potential already on the payroll
chapters.text:
Picture a one-hundred-person team through XQ’s twenty-five, fifty, twenty-five workforce barometer.

Twenty-five are superstars: they consistently exceed role expectations and elevate the team. Protect them, develop them, and multiply their contribution.

Fifty are the at-leasters: they do what is required, with capacity to contribute more. This middle group is a major development opportunity.

Twenty-five are at risk: they need clearer expectations, coaching, support, and accountability to improve their contribution.

The barometer makes the management challenge visible. Where can better alignment and support unlock the greatest improvement? Start with the middle fifty, while strengthening performance across the team.

chapters.title: 06 · Move the middle. Lift the workforce.
chapters.text:
Now set a clear development goal for that team: move from twenty-five, fifty, twenty-five to forty, forty-five, fifteen.

Develop fifteen people from the middle group into top contributors. Help ten people from the at-risk group move into the middle. The result is forty superstars, forty-five in the middle, and fifteen still needing more focused support.

This turns a broad ambition into an operating agenda. Managers know where to focus coaching, recognition, practice, and follow-through. Leaders can track movement alongside output, quality, retention, and adoption.

Move the middle. Build more top contributors. Lift the productive capacity of the workforce already on the payroll.

chapters.title: 07 · Turn strategy into daily behavior
chapters.text:
XQ’s performance engine follows four actions: diagnose, align, activate, and measure.

Diagnose the barriers using performance facts and behavioral insight. Align goals, roles, expectations, and incentives. Activate progress through manager coaching, practice, feedback, and support. Measure output, quality, retention, and adoption.

Connect that cycle across five layers: strategy clarity, leadership alignment, manager execution, employee behavior, and measured results.

Each layer reinforces the next. The strategy becomes clear priorities. Managers translate priorities into expectations and support. Employees turn them into daily action. Results tell the organization where to concentrate its next effort. XQ brings that cycle into recurring workplace conversations.

chapters.title: 08 · Keep talent. Build capability. Sustain progress.
chapters.text:
Retention, training, and motivation become parts of the same performance system.

Help employees see a future inside the company. Give managers practical support for career conversations, recognition, and development plans. Every valuable employee retained preserves experience, relationships, and momentum.

Then make learning useful on the job. Practice a challenging conversation. Apply an AI tool to a real task. Turn a course into an action for this week, reinforced by the manager.

Keep the rhythm moving with clear expectations, useful feedback, and visible progress. XQ helps companies develop the people they have and sustain the conditions that help them perform.

chapters.title: 09 · A small investment. A practical threshold.
chapters.text:
The business model is forty-nine dollars per user per month, paid by the employer: five hundred eighty-eight dollars per year.

At a labor value of seventy-five dollars an hour, just over nine minutes of useful time recovered each week matches the annual subscription. At fifty dollars an hour, the threshold is about fourteen minutes.

Preparing a conversation, resolving a misunderstanding, finding useful guidance, or applying a new skill can all create capacity. Small improvements repeated across a workforce make the buying conversation tangible: connect an everyday problem to measurable value.

chapters.title: 10 · Small gains. Million-dollar potential.
chapters.text:
Take a company with one thousand employees, including two hundred roles where better use of AI could improve productivity. At one hundred thousand dollars in annual loaded cost per role, those roles represent twenty million dollars of capacity.

A five-percent gain creates one million dollars in annual capacity value; ten percent creates two million. The subscription for all one thousand employees costs five hundred eighty-eight thousand dollars a year.

That leaves four hundred twelve thousand to one point four million dollars above subscription cost: a seventy to two hundred forty percent return against the subscription. That is the power of modest gains at workforce scale.

chapters.title: 11 · Make the value visible
chapters.text:
Begin with one hundred to two hundred fifty people and a business priority that matters. Choose a team, a manager population, or a strategic initiative.

Establish the performance baseline and workforce barometer. Agree the goals, owners, and measures. Put XQ into the working day, then track application, output, quality, retention, and progress toward the performance mix.

Useful support creates adoption. Visible progress strengthens the customer relationship. Successful teams become champions for expansion into more roles, more business units, and more strategic priorities. A focused pilot becomes the entry point to an enterprise relationship.

chapters.title: 12 · A market with a clear buyer
chapters.text:
Our target customers have two hundred to twenty thousand or more employees, in sectors including professional services, healthcare administration, technology, financial services, manufacturing, and private-equity portfolios.

The buyer is a chief people officer, chief operating officer, chief executive, or learning leader with a reason to act: improve execution, retain capability, and develop stronger managers.

Land with a paid pilot. Expand through customer value. Extend distribution through advisory partners and industry relationships. Our base-case growth plan reaches three hundred fifty-six million dollars in year-end annual recurring revenue by twenty twenty-nine. Customer success drives the commercial engine.

chapters.title: 13 · XQ’s advantage compounds
chapters.text:
XQ brings behavioral insight, assessments, coaching frameworks, and experience helping people and organizations change. The assessment debrief gives investors a concrete starting point for seeing that expertise delivered through an AI guide.

Bring that foundation into recurring workplace interactions, and the relationship grows with the customer’s priorities. Stronger execution and useful support create reasons to renew and add seats.

In the subscription growth plan, reducing annual customer churn from twenty percent to ten percent adds twenty-five point six million dollars to projected ending annual recurring revenue in twenty twenty-nine. Helping customers perform strengthens XQ’s recurring business.

chapters.title: 14 · Help us turn workforce potential into performance
chapters.text:
We are looking for investment partners who see the opportunity to connect human potential with strategic execution at scale.

Funding accelerates product development, customer deployment, measurement, and distribution. The priorities are paid design partners, strong customer success, and pilots that become enterprise relationships.

The destination is clear: more top contributors, stronger managers, talent that stays, and organizations that capture more value from their strategy and people investment.

XQ brings the behavioral expertise. AI makes personalized support scalable. Recurring value builds a recurring business. Join us in bringing XQ Workforce AI to market. Let’s move the middle and lift the entire workforce.
